evidence.quote: Delivered entirely in English, the program stands out for its innovative and international perspective

notes: Tuition not stated as one amount for a non-EU full-time Bachelor student living abroad: the pages only give a fees calculator/ISEE-based reduction, so tuition is left out. No intakes stated for non-EU applicants; main apply page only says 'Application period has ended' for academic year 2026/27. Documents list not extracted because the apply page refers to external links without naming documents in a quotable list.

evidence.quote: Proficiency in English at B2 level (CEFR) is also required.

note.fr: Un test d'entrée (CEnT-S) est requis pour accéder au programme; vérifiez les modalités et les éventuels entretiens pour les candidats non-UE.
note.en: An entrance test (CEnT-S) is required for admission; check the details and possible interviews for non-EU candidates.

evidence.quote: A basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, and sciences will be assessed through an entrance test.
To participate in the selection process, candidates must take the CEnT-S online test, which is organized by CISIA.

note.fr: Programme à accès restreint (80 places); la sélection se fait sur classement après le test et l'entretien éventuel.
note.en: Restricted-access programme (80 places); selection is based on ranking after the test and possible interview.

evidence.quote: The Bachelor’s Degree in Biotech Engineering for Health is a restricted-access program with a limited number of 80 places.

note.fr: Des lacunes éventuelles en mathématiques, physique et sciences identifiées lors du test doivent être comblées par des obligations de formation supplémentaires (OFA) durant la première année.
note.en: Any gaps in mathematics, physics and sciences identified by the test must be addressed through additional learning requirements (OFA) within the first year.

evidence.quote: Any gaps identified must be addressed through additional learning requirements (OFA) to be completed within the first year.

note.fr: Les documents d'admission doivent être en anglais ou en italien; sinon une traduction officielle et une certification d'authenticité sont requises.
note.en: Admission documents must be in English or Italian; otherwise an official translation and certification of authenticity are required.

evidence.quote: The entry qualification documents are accepted in the following languages: English / Italian.
If this is not available, an official translation will be required, along with certification of the authenticity of the original documents.

note.fr: Les frais de scolarité dépendent du pays d'origine et du cours; utilisez le calculateur de frais pour connaître le montant pour votre cas.
note.en: Tuition fees depend on the country of origin and the course; use the fees calculator to determine the amount for your case.

evidence.quote: The amount for each international student is based on his/her country of origin and the course chosen.
